instruction.text: Ramona bakes 18 cookies. She gives some to her 5 friends. Each friend eats 3 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Dohyun buys 21 apples at the market. He gives some to 10 neighbours. Each neighbour takes 2 apples. How many apples are left?
Iris makes 40 bracelets to sell. She sells to 10 customers. Each customer buys 3 bracelets. How many bracelets are left?
Elijah collects 16 toys. He donates some of them to his 2 cousins. Each cousin takes 6 toys. How many toys are left?
Lucia has 25 pencils. She hands them out to 10 classmates. Each classmate takes 2 pencils. How many pencils are left?
Niran bakes 26 cupcakes for a bake sale. He sells to 9 children. Each child buys 2 cupcakes. How many cupcakes are left?
Freya has 50 stickers. She shares them with 7 friends. Each friend takes 5 stickers. How many stickers are left?
Casper has 32 coins in his pocket. He shares them with his 2 little sisters. Each sister takes 12 coins. How many coins are left?
